summary: Keeps successful Helm chart comparison diagnostics out of release-candidate subject references during idempotent staging retries.
userImpact: Protected release retries can reuse an equivalent staged chart without corrupting the immutable reference passed to Cosign.
security: The candidate workflow still verifies the canonical Helm payload before signing the exact immutable chart subject.
documentation: Generated release notes record the retry-safe candidate staging correction and backward-compatible release impact.
rollback: Revert the workflow output redirection; no application, API, configuration, or database state changes are involved.
validation: Release-candidate workflow contract coverage requires comparison diagnostics to bypass command-substitution stdout.
Protected merge-queue staging must reuse equivalent candidate charts and sign parseable digest-qualified subjects.
